figurative_meaning_en: An extremely passionate or hot-tempered man
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একজন অগ্নি-অবতার, সামান্য কথাতেই রাগে ফেটে পড়ে।
বিপ্লবের নেতা ছিলেন অগ্নি-অবতারের মতো, তাঁর উচ্ছ্বাস সকলকে প্রভাবিত করত।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a firebrand, exploding in anger at the slightest provocation.
The revolutionary leader was like an incarnation of fire, his passion inspiring everyone around him.
history: Derived from Hindu mythological concepts of avatars and the fire god Agni, symbolizing intense energy and transformation in Bengali literary traditions.
note: The idiom draws from Vedic imagery where Agni represents divine fire and power.
